PullRequest.Title: chat: identify cloud sandbox input without relabeling remote hosts
PullRequest.Body:

## Summary

Use the existing input placeholder to say "Chat with Copilot Cloud" for managed cloud conversations and drafts.

Let the connection owner supply this presentation rather than inferring it from the relay address alone. This avoids labeling a remotely connected personal computer, or another agent provider, as a cloud sandbox. No new controls, CSS, authentication changes, or permission changes.

## How to test

Open a cloud draft and a connected cloud conversation: both should show "Chat with Copilot Cloud" in the input hint. An ordinary remote computer and other agent providers should retain their normal hints.

## Validation

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — passed.
- `./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxConnectionCustomization.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/remoteAgentHostChatContribution.test.ts` — 163 passing.
- `npm run typecheck-client` and `npm run valid-layers-check` — passed on the combined validation branch.
- `git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD -- "*.ts" | xargs npm run eslint --` — passed on the combined validation branch.

Not run: manual live-cloud or remote-computer UI verification.

## Wording update

The input hint now reads "Chat with Copilot Cloud". The build and three-suite test command above were rerun successfully (163 passing). `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxConnectionCustomization.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/cloudSandboxConnectionCustomization.test.ts src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/remoteAgentHost/editorCloudSandboxContribution.test.ts` — passed. Provider scoping is unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: A connected remote agent host publishes a new provider and the workbench registers its chat session contribution.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The root-state change callback synchronously iterates the advertised providers and registers only providers absent from connState.agents. The changed placeholder callback runs during that one-time provider registration before registerChatSessionContribution; it is not on typing, rendering, scrolling, or session-message paths.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Best-effort authentication of advertised protected resources through the existing agent connection.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing authentication flow over the advertised agent set on root-state changes; unchanged by the placeholder callback.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same authentication call was initiated before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Started asynchronously and not awaited by provider registration; the changed placeholder computation does not add or move this boundary.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Register the chat session contribution and construct the existing per-provider handlers and models.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Once per newly discovered provider, deduplicated by connState.agents.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same registrations and constructions occurred; the customization registry get and factory also already occurred later in the same method exactly once per provider.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous registration work is on initial provider discovery, but the PR adds only a provider string comparison and scalar placeholder selection.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of newly advertised providers per connection after deduplication by provider. Existing providers only update models and do not re-run the changed code.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Root-state handling and provider registration are synchronous on the event callback. Authentication may proceed asynchronously, but the changed placeholder computation creates no asynchronous work and no concurrency burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: connState.agents is the effective positive cache: once a provider is registered, subsequent root-state updates skip _registerAgent. Removal disposes the entry, so a later genuine re-add computes the placeholder once again. The PR does not alter this lifecycle.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed hunk and full _registerAgent call path show the registry get was moved, not duplicated, and cloud inputPlaceholder performs only boolean/string comparisons with no boundary calls.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider counts vary by host, but effective multiplicity is bounded to newly discovered providers. Exact registration duration is immaterial because the diff adds only constant-time local work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Before and after, one customization lookup/factory execution occurs per newly registered provider; after the PR there is one additional constant-time optional callback invocation.

Scenarios.Scenario: The editor registers the cloud draft session type and discovered cloud-environment session types, then the chat widget reads their input placeholder.
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Registration occurs when the cloud feature is enabled or an environment provider is created. The changed production behavior on this path is only a different localized string value; widget reads remain ordinary scalar reads.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Discover and seed cloud sandbox environments.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing discovery behavior when registration is already active; unaffected by the placeholder text.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Discovery ran under the same conditions before the PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: May populate environment contributions, but the changed constant neither introduces this boundary nor moves it onto a new path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Update the chat input editor options with the registered placeholder.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing updates when session/view state selects a contribution; unchanged frequency.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same widget path displayed the previous localized string.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The renderer receives a slightly different string but performs the same option update and layout path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One creation-type registration plus one contribution per discovered environment. Placeholder length changes by six ASCII characters and does not alter environment discovery cardinality.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Registration is synchronous. Existing discovery and provisioning can be asynchronous, but the string change does not schedule, serialize, or fan out any work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Contributions remain registered in existing DisposableStores for their existing lifetimes. No cache key, retained collection, invalidation, or negative-cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: all changed editor expectations derive from the single localized constant, and no changed code introduces allocations proportional to session history, environment count, or event frequency beyond the same scalar string reference.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact numbers of discovered environments and placeholder refreshes vary, but the diff does not change either multiplicity.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The placeholder wording changes without adding eager work, retained state, boundary calls, or synchronous UI work.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all six changed files and all diff hunks. Traced provider discovery/registration, customization lookup and factory creation, editor cloud contribution registration, widget placeholder consumption, cache/deduplication, concurrency, and transitive expensive boundaries. No actionable performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
